mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_job_posting_recommendation ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, member_id BIGINT NOT NULL, job_id BIGINT NOT NULL, total_score INT NOT NULL, job_score INT NOT NULL, region_score INT NOT NULL, employment_score INT NOT NULL, career_score INT NOT NULL, salary_score INT NOT NULL, work_style_score INT NOT NULL, accessibility_score INT NOT NULL, recommendation_reason VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, mismatch_reason VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_ai_posting_recommendation_member_job UNIQUE (member_id, job_id), CONSTRAINT fk_ai_posting_recommendation_member FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(id), CONSTRAINT fk_ai_posting_recommendation_job FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES job_posting(id) )
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, residence_region, desired_job, desired_region, employment_type, career_type, career_years, min_salary, remote_preferred, flexible_preferred, wheelchair_required, accessible_restroom_required, disabled_parking_required, assistive_device_required FROM job_seeker_profile WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT j.id, j.company_member_id, COALESCE(j.company_name, c.company_name) AS company_name, j.title, j.job_category, j.employment_type, j.location, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.experience_level, j.education_level, j.description, j.requirements, j.preferred_qualifications, j.accessibility_info, j.wheelchair_accessible, j.accessible_restroom, j.disabled_parking, j.remote_available, j.flexible_work_available, j.assistive_device_support, j.deadline, j.status, j.created_at, j.updated_at FROM job_posting j JOIN company_profile c ON c.member_id = j.company_member_id WHERE j.status = 'OPEN' AND (j.deadline IS NULL OR j.deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY j.deadline IS NULL, j.deadline, j.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_job_posting_recommendation SET total_score = #{totalScore}, job_score = #{jobScore}, region_score = #{regionScore}, employment_score = #{employmentTypeScore}, career_score = #{careerScore}, salary_score = #{salaryScore}, work_style_score = #{workStyleScore}, accessibility_score = #{accessibilityScore}, recommendation_reason = #{recommendationReason}, mismatch_reason = #{mismatchReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND job_id = #{jobId}
